Teammates are awesome, and you can build them with any frontier model of your choice on Perplexity. No other product lets you do this.

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Morgan (@morganlinton); megjelent: 2026-11-15T19:32:28+00:00; link: https://x.com/morganlinton/status/2122050119457743189; média: 1 kép]
Perplexity Teammates is really growing on me, really dig that I can select model and effort level.

This has been one of my biggest challenge with other ai assistants, I think it’s limiting if you’re using the same model and effort level for everything.

For anyone following the benchmarking I’ve been doing with @VulcanBench you know how deep I’ve gone into really understanding what model and effort level you need based on things like task complexity.

With ai personal assitants, I don’t need the same model/effort level to do a daily email summary as I do for more complex stock research or code review.

I know in the future, the idea is that labs will determine what model/effort level you need, but right now it’s clear to me that most ai assistants just use the same model and effort level for everything…except for Perplexity.

Personally I’d like to see Grok Bot, Muse, etc. offer something similar. This is pulling me back into the Perplexity camp after quite a hiatus on my part.
